model.description: Model id, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-7, gemini-2.5, qwen-2.5, deepseek-v3

understanding.description: What the player understood about the world (2-4 sentences)

missingInfo.description: Concrete information a player would need to act well

interfaceIssues.description: Raw identifiers, unclear wording, contradictions, leaked or missing facts

expectedNextEvents.description: What the player expects to happen next and why
